input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts
The password reset email link is generated using the BASE_URL constant in src/notifications/templates.ts, which falls back to "http://localhost:3000" if the environment variable PUBLIC_URL is not set. This causes the link in the email to incorrectly point to localhost. The fix is to ensure PUBLIC_URL is correctly set in the environment or adjust the URL generation logic here.
